name: Subarashiki Kokka no Kizukikata
original_name: 素晴らしき国家の築き方
source:
The once prosperous kingdom of Avon now lies in tatters with nothing left in its coffers and a pitiful four citizens to its name. Yet even at its darkest hour, Princess Ariadne is still determined to restore it back to its former glory. Will her perseverance carry her through?

[From [url=https://www.kaguragames.com/product/how-to-build-a-magnificent-kingdom/]Kagura Games[/url]]
